criteria.evidence: Bun-build-backed withWorker creates Miniflare with nodejs_compat, D1, Durable Object, assets, and outbound service support.
bun run --filter @lostgradient/workerd-testing test:slow passes the six binding scenarios.
The integration suite spies on Miniflare.prototype.dispose during a callback failure. With only the await dispose line removed it fails with expected 1 call, received 0. Restored code passes.

Miniflare is cataloged and only a workerd-testing devDependency. testing/workerd explicitly registers its fixture as a Knip test entry: the final test-inclusive and production inventories omit fixture-worker.ts, and miniflare-scoped sharp 0.35.5 and undici 7.30.2 overrides make bun run audit pass.
testing/workerd/README.md documents API, conditions, compatibility settings, flags, and suite integration.
